notes: FRAGILITY: Low-Medium. top-impression-pixel for ads, inline Who to follow/Suggested hiding, Grok removal, Premium upsell hiding. v2.0.1 preserves X's functional sheetDialog/bottomSheet overflow and Share menus, while JavaScript removes only sheets with explicit app-install or account-wall evidence. For You → Following is handled dynamically in filter.js: a `<style id="dull-x-home-foryou">` element is injected only while on `/` or `/home` (and removed on navigation away), hiding `div[role="tablist"] > div:first-child`. Do NOT add that selector back as a static manifest selector — it would apply across all URLs and silently hide the first tab on every tablist on X (profile Posts, Notifications All, Search Latest, etc.). v2.0.2 (2026-10-09) also collapses timeline cells headed by an h2 reading Promoted Post (uBO uAssets filters.txt), which the article-scoped label scan never saw because the heading sits outside the article.
